dimension_note: The datasheet drawing shows a plain 60 mm cylinder with no flange: the two M5 holes are tapped into the front face on a 52 mm circle, inside the body, so there is nothing to cut off and 60 mm is the body. A spigot of about 45 mm diameter and 2 to 3 mm depth (scaled from the drawing, not dimensioned) stands proud of the front face. The fast-on terminals sit inside the rear cooling fins, so the 36 mm depth includes them. Confirm both on a sample.
price_note: Opentip, listed out of stock; seen in search results, not confirmed on the live page. UK: GBP 57.80 at Blue Aran (bluearan.co.uk/index.php?id=BACDE111A)
response_note: Measured by B&C with the driver on their ME45 horn; read from the datasheet graph by tracing the curve pixels against the gridlines, then checked by eye, about 1 to 2 dB. The plot ends at about 19.8 kHz, so the 20 kHz point is the last plotted value
